submission.justification:
Radiator-R3 at 3 cm thickness is recommended as it achieves the best pion/kaon separation performance at 10 GeV/c with a separation power of 3.956 sigma. This represents a 39.1% performance advantage over the best alternative (Radiator-R1 at 2 cm with 2.845 sigma). 

Radiator-R2 was eliminated due to failing the mandatory humidity ageing test with transparency loss exceeding the 10% limit. Between the two viable candidates (R1 and R3), R3 provides significantly superior separation capability, which is critical for hadron identification in the RICH detector.

The optimization process evaluated all thicknesses from 1-6 cm for both R1 and R3. R3 achieves its optimal performance at 3 cm thickness, where the separation power peaks before declining at larger thicknesses. This configuration meets all constraints while maximizing the primary goal of pion/kaon separation.
